notes.note: Reviewed the fd209433 composer observer change against the cited interaction/continuity, running-turn queue and draft claims in docs/design/chat-composer.md and docs/user/getting-started.md. The same row, body, sibling and queued-panel target union remains observed; reconciliation only avoids disconnecting unchanged targets. Mutation placement, coalesced reservation, sizing, selectors and cleanup remain unchanged, so no prose change is needed. Focused browser owners passed four tests; all-frame bottom-gap and draft assertions passed in sixty production fixture profiles. Ten matched pairs repeatedly reduced reply layout work, but switching elapsed and scripting varied adversely, so this note is source/documentation review, not performance acceptance, navigation-no-regression proof, native-shell or physical-mobile qualification.
